notes.title: Content Update!
notes.notes:
Lover’s Enigma Demo Update 1.0.7
[p align="start"]Note: The follow Day 5 content is unfortunately untranslated (for now) We are currently working on the translations for the respective languages that we have and they will be added in into the next (free) update!
[p align="start"]Furthermore, the CGs in Day 5 will be unanimated (for now) but again will also be updated in the next update! We would like to show the current progress of the game as well as share more content with everyone!
[p align="start"]Do keep an eye out on our social media (twitter and itch.io) where we will be posting any announcements in regards to the Demo!!
[p align="start"]Without further ado, the updates:
[p align="start"]New content:

An additional Day 5 has been added, a sneak peek of what’s to come before the routes split off!

Additional CGs have been added for the new day (2 for Haruki, Ryota and Ren, 1 for Kazuki(im sorry kazuki)

Upon visiting Haruki’s office on Day 5, you will be able to interact with some of his items…

Miyabi has (1) new sprite tied to his event on day 5 (Inspired by pompompurin)

TW: Jumpscare at the start of day 5 (be warned)
[p align="start"]Known bugs: (We are currently working on fixing)

On Day 1 in the corridor, if the player clicks on the phone, it will disappear but the phone will not be shown. To bypass this bug, just click on either “Upper Street” or “Neighbour’s Door”, and the next time you go back the corridor, the phone will be working fine.

On Day 4, during some of the dialogue, there might be a “kazuki speaking not found” or “kazuki invismouth not found” during the talk. Please do note that this does not affect gameplay! (Kazuki is just being clingy)

Please also do note that the gallery might not be scrollable but all the CGs are there, even if the last row might be a little cut off :(

We’ve also been fixing bugs ever since the last update, so that might be a bit too long to list…. But if you do encounter any bugs, feel free to send them into our discord server! It would really help us with getting rid of them pesky bugs…. >:)

Abusing the CTRL button to skip dialogue might result in some audio glitches :(
[p align="start"]Anyways, that’s all folks! We hope you will enjoy the new update and we cannot thank you enough for your continuous support!

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
New Features:
-Localization: Added support for Spanish and Russian languages.
-New Animation: A new animated scene has been added at the end of Day 4.
-New Music added ,courtesy of NeetCat! (Main menu, Ryota's theme, Yoko's theme)
-New Easter Egg: A hidden surprise will appear if you name your character after one of the male leads… 

Minor Bug Fixes:
-Tweaked slot machine timing for smoother gameplay.
-Fixed an issue where Miyabi would appear in front of Haruki and stare menacingly during his Day 4 scene.
-Corrected various minor typos throughout the game.
-Fixed a bug where Ryota’s gift on Day 4 wouldn’t appear as intended.
-Resolved a crash issue that could occur after interacting with the window.

Do let us know if there are any issues with the Russian and Spanish localization as this is our first time translating to these languages (,,>﹏<,,)
You can always drop us a message in the discord server: https://discord.gg/CKRfuAPzb3

Thank you again for playing the demo and we hope you enjoy this small update! ( ∩´͈ ᐜ `͈∩)

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
• Ryota now correctly refers to the player's chosen name instead of displaying "MC" during the fight with Mom. 
• Adjusted text positioning in the Temple scene on Day 4 so the Monk’s dialogue stays within the textbox.
• Resolved an issue which caused Ryota's Interaction on Day 4 to bug out.
• Resolved an issue which caused Haruki’s Interaction on Day 3 to bug out.
• Cultists no longer says 'respect' incorrectly
• Window Interaction no longer causes the game to crash
• Ren will no longer crash the game after a certain day 3 interaction 
• Gallery will no longer reset upon starting a new game 
• Mini charas are now slightly larger
• Haruki will now address you by name in a certain interaction and will no longer disrespect you by calling you 'MC'

[New Feature]
• Autoplay Mode is now available! Players can now sit back and enjoy the story at a comfortable reading pace. A new Autoplay button has been added.
• History log has been added
[you can now view the previous conversations you have had] 

We're still working on tweaking the mini games, which will be updated to be much more accurate in the next major patch.
Thank you for your continuous support! ✺◟(＾∇＾)◞✺ Do let us know if you encounter anymore bugs (૭ ｡•̀ ᵕ •́｡ )૭ Happy romancing!
